notes: Job Agent 2.9.4 beta adds safe local database cleanup: manually delete one vacancy or bulk-remove entries whose latest saved snapshot is older than 30, 60, 90 or 180 days. Preview affected counts and confirm; preserve submitted, favorite and queued entries plus all applications history. A timestamped backup is saved locally before snapshots are removed. Permanent INACTIVE tombstones prevent deleted vacancies from returning in the Dashboard or after a new search. The existing reversible inactive archive is retained and its filter is now accessible in the UI. Archived/deleted IDs are skipped before browser enrichment, reducing wasted work. 42 offline regression tests passed in GitHub Actions. Cover-letter behavior is unchanged.
